_note: Kaos's voice. Owner-controlled: the engine reads this and never writes it. voice_id stays empty until the owner picks one of the previews (python -m gme voice previews, then voice save). Never put the API key here; it lives in ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.

design.name: Kaos
design.description: A young adult male, quick and over-caffeinated, with a warm, cheeky British accent. Confident and playful, slightly chaotic energy, talks fast and laughs at himself. Friendly and never mean. Clear and punchy for short social videos.
design.preview_text: Right, okay so, I ran out of money six days before payday. Again. But then I opened StackUp, and it told me exactly what was safe to spend. Turns out the answer was not another takeaway. Stay chained.
